results.title: All Dimasa Students' Union Flags Illegal Riverbed Mining in Dima Hasao
results.description: The All Dimasa Students' Union (ADSU), Dima Hasao District Committee, has lodged a formal complaint with the Chief Conservator of Forests, Haflong, seeking immediate action against what it described as illegal and unregulated riverbed mining across the district.
